overview: This file consists of a 17 November 1934 despatch from the American Consul General in Tokyo transmitting English translations of two colonial Taiwan regulations concerning the admission, registration, residence, surveillance, and deportation of aliens. The first regulation, issued in February 1918, establishes grounds for refusing entry, passport and visa requirements, police examination, and exemptions for diplomats, officials, and ships’ crews. The second, issued in July 1899, requires reports by foreign residents, lodgers, landlords, and hotelkeepers; creates police registers of foreigners; authorizes deportation; and prescribes fines and imprisonment. Both translated regulations appear twice in the file, apparently as duplicate or carbon copies, with substantial OCR corruption in the second set.

people.name: C. Matsuo
people.role: Interpreter and translator of the enclosed regulations

subfiles.title: Despatch from Arthur Garrels transmitting Taiwan alien regulations
subfiles.about: The Consul General forwards translations of Taiwan’s rules governing the admission and temporary residence of aliens.
subfiles.summary: Garrels forwards Taiwan's alien regulations, differing from Japan proper, applying equally to visitors and workers.

subfiles.title: Translation of Taiwan Government Order No. 7 on the landing of foreigners
subfiles.about: The order specifies passport requirements and the grounds on which colonial authorities may refuse entry to or deport a foreigner.
subfiles.summary: Translation: Taiwan's Order No. 7 bars foreigners lacking documents or deemed threats, requiring visas, exempting diplomats and ship crews.

subfiles.title: Regulations Concerning Treatment of Aliens, Taiwan Government General Order No. 71
subfiles.about: The regulation establishes police reporting and registration requirements for foreigners residing or lodging in Taiwan and provides penalties and deportation powers.
subfiles.summary: Translation: Taiwan's Order No. 71 requires hosts and foreign residents to register with police, who may deport indigents or troublemakers.

subfiles.title: Duplicate translation of Taiwan Government Order No. 7
subfiles.about: This is a duplicate, more heavily OCR-corrupted copy of the regulation governing the landing and exclusion of foreigners.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate translation repeats Order No. 7's grounds for excluding foreigners and its passport, visa, and deportation rules, preserving exemptions for diplomats and ship crews.

subfiles.title: Duplicate translation of Taiwan Government General Order No. 71
subfiles.about: This duplicate copy restates Taiwan’s reporting, registration, policing, deportation, and penalty provisions for aliens.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate translation repeats Order No. 71's foreigner-registration and deportation rules, naming C. Matsuo as interpreter, though the location is OCR-corrupted.

interest: Shows Japanese colonial Taiwan's border exclusion and police registration of foreigners, distinct from rules in Japan proper.
